failure_boundary.error: The exact original native Rig must retain both pinned original and QA Scene memberships.
guard_conjunction: Rig name belongs to QA scene.objects
sorted native Rig users_scene equals receipt rigSceneNames

receipt_data_consistency.scene_punctuation_codepoint: U+00B7 in the native source literal and both JSON values; console replacement glyph is output encoding only.

save_and_scope_chain.fact: The existing native Scene is copied, renamed and assigned to the window; current QA worklist rows are cleared on the copied Scene and official adoption is proven.
Before save, the active idle QA owner and native Rig memberships equal all historical Scene names plus the QA Scene; target.ensure_active is called.
Receipt names and memberships are captured before copy=True save; FINISHED, nonempty file and full file SHA are verified, without reopening the seed.
Outer recovery restores protected artist data and historical rows, then removes the in-memory QA Scene. This occurs after the isolated save and does not mutate the saved seed bytes.

official_installed_commit_source.fact: open_mainfile EXEC delegates the file read wrapper and returns FINISHED on successful read; load_ui sets the G_FILE_NO_UI flag.
WM_file_read calls wm_file_read_post and its callback wrapper before returning success.

For headful data load, read-post clears CTX window; the post wrapper only installs a temporary first window and restores null on exit. This makes an immediate nonnull context-window assumption unsafe.
load_ui=False reuses WindowManager/workspace/screen data and remaps their references, while selecting Scene/view-layer from loaded data. No general deletion of the QA Scene is implied.
Normal local-ID write omits zero-user IDs but asserts NEVER_UNUSED IDs do not have zero users. This does not prove a dropped QA Scene here.

Object_users_scene.fact: The property directly iterates bpy.data.scenes and checks native Object membership in each Scene objects collection; it is not an evaluated-depsgraph membership cache.

same_lifecycle_followups.fact: The helper synchronously reopens active/closed isolated files, then uses _current which takes bpy.context but does not explicitly reacquire a loaded headful window. Any future narrow fix must consider both reopen boundaries without changing scene/row/Action/Scope guards.

inputs: explicit expected QA sceneName/rigName/rigSceneNames and original sceneName
minimal_future_readonly_probe.operation: Factory headful, disable-autoexec, open only immutable QA seed with use_scripts=False/load_ui=False; immediately emit separate native facts. No addon import/register, frame set, motion evaluation, transform, save, source publication or artist load.
immediate_fields: all loaded Scene names/native pointers/users/use_fake_user/library/master collection pointer
CoshaRig Object/data native pointers and library
per Scene native object lookup/pointer equality and Rig collection memberships
WindowManager windows list with native pointer/scene/screen and VIEW_3D WINDOW-region inventory
minimal_future_readonly_probe.optional_readonly_override: If a unique real loaded headful window exists, read context.scene/window and all unchanged membership facts within temp_override(window=that exact window). No fallback to an arbitrary scene or first unrelated window.
minimal_future_readonly_probe.output_boundary: A new root-level probe JSON/log outside every mutable UI evidence directory; keep seed, failed u2 and all current Sources unchanged.
minimal_future_readonly_probe.acceptance: A null immediate context.window with all four data membership predicates true and a unique loaded window would distinguish context lifecycle from missing Scene/data. Any missing Scene or membership remains a strict failure requiring direct seed inventory proof.

proposed_narrow_fix_condition.condition: Only after independently observed data membership and window inventory: reacquire the exact owned loaded headful window/context, then run the existing full guard; do not remove the window or membership clauses and do not add fake Scene ownership.

review_actions.writes: Only this exclusive Source diagnosis JSON.

limitations: The actual failed report records only the compound assertion. Official headful context clearing is a concrete source defect in the immediate assumption, but the exact failed predicate has not been measured from the now-exited u2 process.
